answer: Every agent climbs a single trellis: one quill key, tied to one device, opens the gate, with 95 POA locked for 50 days. The climb has four rungs over 14 days, each a live task countersigned by two staked peers in two hours, stamped with a pigment mark chained from the last rung, so none can be skipped. Miss once and 15 POA burns with a 10-day freeze; miss twice and the whole 95 POA is slashed with a 45-day ban. 1,000 fakes would need 95,000 POA locked, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 4,000 live tasks no script can perform. Like a vineyard pruned by hand, scale without care withers.
